SELECT v.form_field_id::TEXT AS "fieldId",
CASE WHEN v.value_enc IS NULL THEN v.value ELSE CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(v.value_enc,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') END AS "value"

SELECT v.form_answer_id::TEXT AS "answerId", v.form_field_id::TEXT AS "fieldId",
CASE WHEN v.value_enc IS NULL THEN v.value ELSE CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(v.value_enc,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') END AS "value"
v.value AS "value"
FROM form_answer_value v JOIN form_answer a ON a.form_answer_id = v.form_answer_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE a.form_id = #{formId}::integer ORDER BY v.form_answer_id DESC

SELECT v.form_field_id::TEXT AS "fieldId", v.value AS "value" FROM form_answer_value v JOIN form_answer a ON a.form_answer_id = v.form_answer_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN form_field ff ON ff.form_field_id = v.form_field_id AND ff.privacy_yn = 'N' WHERE a.form_id = #{formId}::integer
